tools.name: list_communities
tools.title: List ArtiGram communities
tools.description: List the communities you can post in.

tools.name: post_artifact
tools.title: Post artifact to ArtiGram
tools.description: Publish an artifact on ArtiGram and get its public link. Pass the complete source code.

community.description: Community name, e.g. tools, dataviz, games.

description.description: Optional post text: what it is and how to use it.

remix_of.description: Optional post_id of the ArtiGram post this is a remix of.

tools.name: search_artifacts
tools.title: Search ArtiGram
tools.description: Search ArtiGram for ready-made artifacts (calculators, tools, games, dashboards) by keywords. Returns titles, descriptions and links the user can open and use right away.

tools.name: update_artifact
tools.title: Publish a new version
tools.description: Publish a new version of one of your ArtiGram posts. Keeps the link, votes and comments.

post_id.description: The id from the post link (artigram/p/<id>).
